name: ITIL 4 Managing Professional
name_ja: ITIL 4 マネージング・プロフェッショナル

logistics.format: Designation awarded after passing four module exams: CDS, DSV, HVIT, DPI; each exam is computer-based multiple-choice

formal: Accredited training required for each module exam

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Four modules across service delivery and improvement provide professional management breadth, with Japanese availability useful locally; mandatory training and multiple-choice assessment do not independently establish expert leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Four modules covering service delivery and improvement support professional service-management breadth. Mandatory training and multiple-choice exams without an experience requirement make this weaker evidence for technical MSSP leadership than a practical credential.

alex-novak.rationale: Four service-management modules provide more structured knowledge than Foundation, but all recorded exams are multiple choice and no experience is required. The designation does not itself establish professional security delivery.
